title: 连动结构的主次
goal: 能确定主要谓语并表达附属动作。

points.label: 确定连续动作中的主要谓语
用适当结构表达附属动作

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文可以把几个动词连着用，表示目的、方式或伴随。译成英文时，先定下主要谓语。其余动作用不定式、介词短语或分词表达。分词表示的动作，主体要和主句的主语相同。

body.box:
原文：村民修建水渠，把河水引入农田。
译文：Villagers built a channel to bring river water into the fields.

cards.title: 目的
rows: 工人修建了围栏来保护幼树。
Workers built a fence to protect the young trees.
built 是主要谓语，to protect 表目的。
学生前往档案馆查阅旧报纸。
Students went to the archive to consult old newspapers.
went 是主要谓语，to consult 表目的。
渔民修补渔网以便再次出海捕鱼。
Fishers repaired their nets to go fishing again.
repaired 是主要谓语，to go fishing 表目的。
图书馆延长开放时间以服务读者。
The library extended its hours to serve readers.
to serve 表示延长时间的目的。

cards.title: 方式
rows: 工匠通过打磨木材制作光滑的器皿。
Craftspeople make smooth vessels by polishing wood.
make 是谓语，by polishing 表方式。
研究人员通过比较照片记录河道变化。
Researchers record changes in the channel by comparing photographs.
record 是谓语，by comparing 表方式。
农户通过收集雨水减少自来水用量。
Farmers reduce tap water use by collecting rainwater.
by collecting 表示减少用量的方式。
学生通过阅读信件了解当地家庭的历史。
Students learn about local family history by reading letters.
by reading 表示了解的方式。

cards.title: 伴随与主体
rows: 导游走进展厅，向参观者介绍这些画作。
The guide entered the gallery, introducing the paintings to visitors.
entered 是谓语，introducing 的主体也是 guide。
老人坐在窗边，讲述小镇过去的故事。
The old man sat by the window, telling stories about the town's past.
sat 是谓语，telling 的主体也是 old man。
学生拍摄照片，记录这座建筑的变化。
Students took photographs, documenting changes in the building.
documenting 的主体是 students。
雨停后，工人开始修理受损的屋顶。
After the rain stopped, workers began repairing the damaged roof.
雨停的主体是 rain，和 workers 不同，用 after 引出从句。

items.stem: 原文：工人修建堤坝来保护附近的农田。选择译句。
options: Workers built a levee to protect nearby fields.
Workers built a levee and protected nearby fields.
Workers built a levee, protected nearby fields.
Workers building a levee to protect nearby fields.
items.why: 「来」表示修堤坝的目的，built 是主要谓语，to protect 表目的。第二项把目的写成了已经做完的另一件事。

items.stem: 原文：农民通过轮作保持土壤的肥力。选择译句。
options: Farmers rotate crops by maintaining soil fertility.
Farmers maintain soil fertility by rotating crops.
Farmers maintain soil fertility to rotate crops.
Farmers maintain soil fertility and rotate crops.
items.why: 「通过轮作」是方式，主要谓语是 maintain，by rotating crops 表方式。第一项把方式和结果颠倒了。

items.stem: 原文：学生前往工坊学习传统木工技艺。排列译句。
items.why: went 是主要谓语，to learn 表示前往的目的。

items.stem: 原文：园丁通过收集雨水为菜园浇水。排列译句。
items.why: waters 是主要谓语，by collecting 引出方式。

items.stem: 原文：老师走进教室，手里拿着一本旧书。选择译句。
options: The teacher entered the classroom, held an old book.
The teacher entered the classroom to hold an old book.
The teacher entered the classroom, holding an old book.
Holding an old book, the classroom was entered by the teacher.
items.why: 「手里拿着」是伴随动作，entered 是谓语，holding 的主体是 teacher。第一项用逗号直接连了两个谓语。

items.stem: 原文：工匠们打开窗户，让室内空气流通。排列译句。
items.why: opened 是谓语，to let 表示开窗的目的。

items.stem: 原文：村民修建水渠来灌溉附近的农田。选择译句。
options: Villagers irrigated nearby fields to build a channel.
Villagers built a channel, irrigated nearby fields.
Villagers built a channel by irrigating nearby fields.
Villagers built a channel to irrigate nearby fields.
items.why: 「来」表示修水渠的目的，built 是主要谓语，to irrigate 表目的。第三项把目的写成了方式。

items.stem: 原文：研究人员通过对比地图追踪河岸变化。选择译句。
options: Researchers track changes in the riverbank by comparing maps.
Researchers compare maps by tracking changes in the riverbank.
Researchers track changes in the riverbank to compare maps.
Researchers track changes in the riverbank and compare maps.
items.why: 「通过对比地图」是方式，主要谓语是 track，by comparing maps 表方式。第二项把方式和主要动作颠倒了。

items.stem: 原文：讲解员走进展厅，向来宾展示一幅画。选择译句。
options: The guide entered the gallery, showed guests a painting.
The guide entered the gallery, showing guests a painting.
Showing guests a painting, the gallery was entered by the guide.
The guests entered the gallery, showing the guide a painting.
items.why: 走进和展示的主体都是讲解员，showing 的主体与 entered 的主语 the guide 一致。第三项 showing 的主体成了 the gallery。

items.stem: 原文：工人通过清除树枝疏通了山间小路。选择译句。
options: Workers removed branches by clearing the mountain path.
Removing branches, the mountain path was cleared by workers.
Workers cleared the mountain path by removing branches.
Workers cleared the mountain path to remove branches.
items.why: 清除树枝是疏通小路的方式，by removing branches 表方式。第四项把方式写成了目的。

items.stem: 原文：学生走进图书馆查找有关植物的书籍。排列译句。
items.why: entered 是主要谓语，to find 表示目的。

items.stem: 原文：农户通过晾晒谷物减少储存时的水分。排列译句。
items.why: reduce 是主要谓语，by drying 表示方式。

items.stem: 原文：画家坐在窗边，描绘远处的山峰。排列译句。
items.why: depicting 的逻辑主体是主句主语 painter。

items.stem: 原文：志愿者张贴告示，提醒游客保护花木。排列译句。
items.why: posted 是主要谓语，to remind 表达张贴告示的目的。
